verdict.rationale: Pulley documents its own 83(b) Election status tracker as a cap table tool, and its compliance product claims to handle tax filings alongside ASC 718 reporting. Neither Rule 701 threshold tracking nor Form 3921 generation is named, and nothing shows filings are generated automatically from the cap table. Missing for 10: Rule 701 disclosure-threshold monitoring, Form 3921 generation, evidence of automatic generation from cap table data, depth on the 83(b) tracker, independent corroboration.
